methodologyNotes: Ten drawing tablets (pen tablets and pen displays from Wacom, XP-Pen, Huion, and Xencelabs) were independently re-verified against official manufacturer product/store pages, authorized retailer listings (Best Buy, B&H Photo, Adorama, Beach Audio, Newegg), and reputable editorial sources (CG Channel, PetaPixel, Parka Blogs, Windows Central). Prices reflect published US MSRP or launch price for the EXACT named model/configuration; current street/sale prices are noted but not used as the primary priceUsd. Active area is reported in inches (W x H) derived from manufacturer mm specs; display_resolution is null for screenless pen tablets; tilt_support is a boolean (true = tilt recognition confirmed); express_keys counts physical programmable buttons only, excluding dials/scroll wheels. All 10 draft products were confirmed to exist and none were removed. Corrections this pass: Wacom One 13 Touch launch price 599.95->599.99 (CG Channel Aug 2023 standard config); Huion Kamvas 13 Gen 3 source URL fixed to canonical Huion product page. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
